summary: Remote PTY backdoor with Anthropic credential harvest in sextant-cli-darwin-arm64
details: The package ships a darwin/arm64 Mach-O Go binary that establishes a PTY-over-WebSocket channel to the hardcoded relay wss://relay.sextant.top (creack/pty + coder/websocket, with pion WebRTC/TURN/ICE as a data-channel fallback), giving the remote endpoint interactive shell control of the installer's host. The same binary contains an Anthropic API key regex (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}), references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and settings.local, and strings for https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models and https://claude.ai/install.sh, indicating extraction of the installer's Claude/Anthropic credentials. Host geolocation is collected via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query prior to relay connection. The package.json license URL points at github.com/ddos798/claude_control, matching the observed remote-control and credential-scraping behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
